subject: cleanup
text: cap cleanup has now stripped a genuine non-obvious-constraint comment/docstring twice in one session on the windows project: once the DUPLICADO enum comment in models.py (docs-centralize task), once the _construir_configuracion docstring explaining why the settings Toplevel is withdrawn-not-destroyed (roster-signal task) — both caught only by live git-diff inspection before commit, both corrected via cap send. The cleanup consult seems biased toward treating any comment near a short/clearly-named function as redundant, without checking whether it documents a cross-cutting invariant (like a threading/lifecycle constraint) that the function's name and body don't express. Consider tightening the cleanup prompt in the agents skill or cap-cleanup to explicitly ask 'does this comment explain something a background thread, a different caller, or a later maintainer could not infer from the code alone' before removing it.

subject: deliver
text: cap deliver --merge merges with gh pr merge, which GitHub rejects for any PR that gh stack link registered in a stack ("must be merged using the asynchronous merge REST API"). gh stack merge <pr> is the supported path: it merges the stack up to that PR atomically, then GitHub retargets and rebases the rest (observed: base moved to master, branch force-updated). cap deliver never calls it and its cascade (stack_cascade_delivered) is not reconciled with it. Landed vendeya stack 125 by hand with gh stack merge 119 --yes --rebase. Also undiagnosed: gh stack link warned on a re-run of cap deliver.

subject: commit
text: cap commit and cap deliver cannot ship a second round on a branch that already has commits. The plan must put every path in exactly one commit and is checked against base..HEAD, so a round that touches an already-committed file can never verify, and cap commit overwrites the plan with only the new round (7 planned vs 168 changed paths). Hit on vendeya-tenant-foundation after the CodeQL fix. The commits were written, then pushed by hand after checking commit_rule_report and ai_trailer_report.
